question: Does prior strong-versus-weak cohort feedback distinguish the observed payoff distribution of both existing reclaim exit policies across both periods and all three boards?

rules.population: All8155 original UR formations, each retaining both complete existing account dispositions; no outcome, admission, holding or maturity-based deletion. No new account or signal is run.
rules.clock: For original formation T, use exact prior source-calendar A=T-1. Freeze groups at F=A-5=T-6, using RS20 from F-20 through F, and feedback from F through A. All required slots are exact, never compressed. T-close and subsequent prices cannot affect this context.
rules.rank: Within each unchanged board-period source cohort, reuse batch35 RS20 and midrank definitions on all valid21-slot members and the shared CSI300 benchmark. Top percentile>=0.90; bottom percentile<=0.10. Retain all ties, so group sizes may differ or be empty. No in-period universe substitution.
rules.feedback: Each fixed member has raw closeA/closeF-1 positive, flat, negative, or unknown. All six source slots require the inherited valid raw OHLCV and known-status checks. Unknown members remain in their frozen group denominator.
rules.bounds: For each group N=P+Z+L+U, positive fraction lies in[P/N,(P+U)/N]. Difference lowerNumerator=Ps*Nw-(Pw+Uw)*Ns; upperNumerator=(Ps+Us)*Nw-Pw*Ns; denominator=Ns*Nw. Compare integer numerators: lower>0 stronger; upper<0 weaker; both zero equal; otherwise unknown. Either empty group is unknown. Do not round, add epsilon, or impose a coverage filter.
rules.meaning: The state measures already-observed positive-feedback proportions of previously strong and weak groups. Stronger can occur when both groups mostly fall, weaker when both mostly rise. It does not identify bull/bear regimes, causality, ownership, quantitative funds or future returns.
rules.attribution: Map closed episodes and terminal open realized/unrealized PnL to their original formation context. Preserve failed/unexecuted signals and cutoff positions. Report original account residual separately; do not allocate it to any state. Money divided by original500000 is a contribution, never a filtered account return.
rules.groups: Explicit complete matrices:48 overall,96 formation-year,72 formation-epoch,24 policy-difference groups. Include empty and unknown cells. Each of12 account bridges reconciles all opportunity/episode counts and money. Closed means condition on both execution and maturity.
rules.epochs: The user-directed2024-09-24 boundary is descriptive only. Formation cohorts differ from existing continuous equity intervals; retain all12 original pre/post curve rows with carried cash and positions. Old2022-2023 capital remains separate.
rules.comparison: Contrast volatilityTrail minus trail10 group money and counts. Different exits change subsequent admissions, sizes and capital paths; this is not a matched-trade causal estimate or a tested market filter.
rules.validation: Freeze new analytical code, tests, inputs and rules before new context extraction. Independently reconstruct every source-day rank, both fixed member lists and integer bounds, then every disposition, aggregate and account bridge. Cross-check the top group against batch35 on overlapping A dates.
rules.novelty: The new component is the symmetric weak-cohort comparator and bound on the difference. Strong-cohort feedback,20-session rank,5-session feedback and0.90 top percentile were already examined. This is an exploratory diagnostic on exposed development data, not a newly untouched validation.

conceptReferences.meaning: General breadth counts participation; our fixed-cohort relative-feedback definition is independently specified and is not the advance-decline line or an endorsed strategy.

limitations: All2022-2025 histories have been inspected and used for development;2026 is excluded and no holdout claim is made.
Present-day surviving local files, fixed pre-start cohorts, raw prices and incomplete historical membership, status, rights and execution evidence remain material limitations.
Formation-time grouping is descriptive. Neither positive group PnL nor a difference between exit policies proves an executable filter would earn that amount.
Closed episodes and open positions have different maturity. Preserve tail concentration, open PnL, pending exits, valuation flags and unallocated residuals.
Known sign under unknown-member bounds is not complete observation of all members. Empty/tied populations and bounds touching zero remain explicit.
Board listing category is not industry; the common benchmark is not board-matched. Price-volume evidence cannot establish institutional, retail or quantitative-fund identity.
Overlapping dates and repeated stocks are dependent observations; no independent-sample significance, winner promotion or fixed profit hurdle is claimed.
